descriptor.scope: Public surveyed and approved urban cadastral Erven. Bounded Centurion evidence only; citywide completeness, registration, legal title, survey accuracy and current-ground status are unestablished.
descriptor.licenceNote: Anonymous access is verified. Explicit geometry reuse and redistribution terms remain unestablished; attribution is Chief Surveyor-General.

followUps: The prior 2026-10-11 Centurion run recorded 12 persistent overlaps above 0.01 m² totaling 0.315699 m². This three-key initial check cannot clear that finding; retain it for bounded second-pass reread without changing geometry.

EPSG:4148 is declared by current layer metadata; outSR=4326 yields longitude,latitude output. Provider-selected datum operation, reference-frame realization, epoch and grids remain unverified. No offset or geometry correction is applied.
Current/historic semantics of LSTATUS, WSTATUS and dates remain unresolved. No undocumented status filter is applied and no status or personal attributes are requested.
Area completeness, forced paging equality, binding, explicit absence and runtime UI are second-pass checks. These three separated district samples do not prove citywide coverage.
Explicit reuse/redistribution permission is unresolved; public anonymous access alone does not establish a licence.
